_comment: Vintage Story dedicated server (custom egg, x64, .NET 10)
name: Vintage Story
author: 1yuk1@users.noreply.github.com
description: Vintage Story dedicated server 1.22.x (x64). Downloads server files from official CDN, requires custom image ghcr.io/1yuk1/vintage-story-egg-s.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Vintage Story dedicated server installer
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -e

apt update
apt -y install curl ca-certificates

VERSION="${VS_VERSION:-1.22.7}"
URL="https://cdn.vintagestory.at/gamefiles/stable/vs_server_linux-x64_${VERSION}.tar.gz"

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

echo "Downloading Vintage Story server ${VERSION}"
echo "URL: ${URL}"
curl -fSL -o vs_server.tar.gz "${URL}"

# Чистим файлы старой версии, чтобы не осталось устаревших ассетов
if [ -d "assets" ]; then
    echo "Removing old installation files"
    rm -rf assets/ Lib/
fi

tar -xzf vs_server.tar.gz
rm -f vs_server.tar.gz server.sh

mkdir -p data
chmod +x VintagestoryServer || true

echo "Installation completed"
